+import android.content.Context

+import kotlin.math.asin
+import kotlin.math.sqrt
+
+class SmartMotionCalibrationActivity : AppCompatActivity(), SensorEventListener {
+
+    override fun attachBaseContext(newBase: Context) {
+        super.attachBaseContext(LanguageManager.applyLanguage(newBase))
+    }
+
+    private enum class Phase {
+        IDLE,
+        STILL,
+        FORWARD,
+        COMPLETE
+    }
+
+    private lateinit var tvProfile: TextView
+    private lateinit var tvStatus: TextView
+    private lateinit var tvDetails: TextView
+    private lateinit var tvHint: TextView
+    private lateinit var progress: ProgressBar
+    private lateinit var btnStart: Button
+    private lateinit var btnClear: Button
+
+    private lateinit var sensorManager: SensorManager
+    private var accelerometer: Sensor? = null
+    private var gyroscope: Sensor? = null
+
+    private var profileId: Long = -1L
+    private var phase: Phase = Phase.IDLE
+    private var phaseStartMs: Long = 0L
+    private var calibrationActive: Boolean = false
+
+    private val gravityLp = FloatArray(3)
+    private var gravityLpInitialized = false
+
+    private val stillGravitySum = FloatArray(3)
+    private val stillMaxAxis = FloatArray(3)
+    private var stillLinearMagSum = 0f
+    private var stillLinearGoodCount = 0
+    private var stillLinearCount = 0
+
+    private val stillGyroBiasSum = FloatArray(3)
+    private var stillGyroMagSum = 0f
+    private var stillGyroGoodCount = 0
+    private var stillGyroCount = 0
+
+    private data class WeightedVector(val magnitude: Float, val vector: FloatArray)
+    private val forwardTopVectors = mutableListOf<WeightedVector>()
+    private var forwardAcceptedSamples = 0
+    private var forwardSampleCount = 0
+    private var forwardTrigger = 0.6f
+
+    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+        setContentView(R.layout.activity_smart_motion_calibration)
+        applySystemBarsPaddingToRoot()
+
+        window.statusBarColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.dark_background)
+
+        profileId = intent.getLongExtra("PROFILE_ID", ProfileStorage.getSelectedProfileId(this))
+
+        DragCalibration.init(this)
+        DragCalibration.setProfile(profileId)
+
+        supportActionBar?.setDisplayHomeAsUpEnabled(true)
+        supportActionBar?.title = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_title)
+
+        tvProfile = findViewById(R.id.tvSmartCalibrationProfile)
+        tvStatus = findViewById(R.id.tvSmartCalibrationStatus)
+        tvDetails = findViewById(R.id.tvSmartCalibrationDetails)
+        tvHint = findViewById(R.id.tvSmartCalibrationHint)
+        progress = findViewById(R.id.progressSmartCalibration)
+        btnStart = findViewById(R.id.btnSmartCalibrationStart)
+        btnClear = findViewById(R.id.btnSmartCalibrationClear)
+
+        val profileName = ProfileStorage.loadProfiles(this).find { it.id == profileId }?.name ?: "Unknown"
+        tvProfile.text = profileName
+
+        sensorManager = getSystemService(SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager
+        accelerometer = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER)
+        gyroscope = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE)
+
+        if (accelerometer == null) {
+            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.lean_calibration_sensor_missing), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
+            finish()
+            return
+        }
+
+        btnStart.setOnClickListener {
+            startCalibration()
+        }
+
+        btnClear.setOnClickListener {
+            MotionCalibrationStore.clearSnapshot(this, profileId)
+            LeanCalibrationStore.clearAll(this, profileId)
+            updateStoredCalibrationUi()
+            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.smart_calibration_cleared), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
+        }
+
+        updateStoredCalibrationUi()
+    }
+
+    override fun onResume() {
+        super.onResume()
+        if (calibrationActive) {
+            registerSensors()
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun onPause() {
+        super.onPause()
+        if (calibrationActive) {
+            unregisterSensors()
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun onDestroy() {
+        super.onDestroy()
+        unregisterSensors()
+    }
+
+    override fun onSupportNavigateUp(): Boolean {
+        finish()
+        return true
+    }
+
+    private fun startCalibration() {
+        resetRuntimeState()
+        phase = Phase.STILL
+        phaseStartMs = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
+        calibrationActive = true
+
+        btnStart.isEnabled = false
+        btnClear.isEnabled = false
+        tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_status_still)
+        tvHint.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_hint_still)
+        tvDetails.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_waiting_data)
+        progress.progress = 0
+
+        registerSensors()
+    }
+
+    private fun registerSensors() {
+        accelerometer?.let { sensorManager.registerListener(this, it, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_GAME) }
+        gyroscope?.let { sensorManager.registerListener(this, it, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_GAME) }
+    }
+
+    private fun unregisterSensors() {
+        accelerometer?.let { sensorManager.unregisterListener(this, it) }
+        gyroscope?.let { sensorManager.unregisterListener(this, it) }
+    }
+
+    private fun resetRuntimeState() {
+        phase = Phase.IDLE
+        phaseStartMs = 0L
+        calibrationActive = false
+        gravityLpInitialized = false
+        stillGravitySum.fill(0f)
+        stillMaxAxis.fill(0f)
+        stillLinearMagSum = 0f
+        stillLinearGoodCount = 0
+        stillLinearCount = 0
+        stillGyroBiasSum.fill(0f)
+        stillGyroMagSum = 0f
+        stillGyroGoodCount = 0
+        stillGyroCount = 0
+        forwardTopVectors.clear()
+        forwardAcceptedSamples = 0
+        forwardSampleCount = 0
+        forwardTrigger = 0.6f
+    }
+
+    override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent?) {
+        val ev = event ?: return
+        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
+
+        when (ev.sensor.type) {
+            Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER -> handleAccelerometer(ev, now)
+            Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE -> handleGyroscope(ev)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun handleAccelerometer(ev: SensorEvent, nowMs: Long) {
+        val ax = ev.values[0]
+        val ay = ev.values[1]
+        val az = ev.values[2]
+
+        if (!gravityLpInitialized) {
+            gravityLp[0] = ax
+            gravityLp[1] = ay
+            gravityLp[2] = az
+            gravityLpInitialized = true
+        }
+
+        val alpha = if (phase == Phase.FORWARD) 0.97f else 0.92f
+        gravityLp[0] = alpha * gravityLp[0] + (1f - alpha) * ax
+        gravityLp[1] = alpha * gravityLp[1] + (1f - alpha) * ay
+        gravityLp[2] = alpha * gravityLp[2] + (1f - alpha) * az
+
+        if (phase == Phase.STILL) {
+            val lx = ax - gravityLp[0]
+            val ly = ay - gravityLp[1]
+            val lz = az - gravityLp[2]
+            val lMag = norm3(lx, ly, lz)
+
+            stillGravitySum[0] += gravityLp[0]
+            stillGravitySum[1] += gravityLp[1]
+            stillGravitySum[2] += gravityLp[2]
+            stillLinearMagSum += lMag
+            stillLinearCount++
+
+            stillMaxAxis[0] = maxAbs(stillMaxAxis[0], lx)
+            stillMaxAxis[1] = maxAbs(stillMaxAxis[1], ly)
+            stillMaxAxis[2] = maxAbs(stillMaxAxis[2], lz)
+
+            if (lMag <= STILL_LINEAR_GOOD_THRESHOLD) {
+                stillLinearGoodCount++
+            }
+
+            val elapsed = nowMs - phaseStartMs
+            progress.progress = ((elapsed.toFloat() / STILL_DURATION_MS.toFloat()) * 50f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 50)
+            tvDetails.text = String.format(
+                Locale.getDefault(),
+                getString(R.string.smart_calibration_metrics_still),
+                stillLinearCount,
+                if (stillLinearCount > 0) stillLinearMagSum / stillLinearCount else 0f
+            )
+
+            if (elapsed >= STILL_DURATION_MS) {
+                beginForwardPhase(nowMs)
+            }
+        } else if (phase == Phase.FORWARD) {
+            val lx = ax - gravityLp[0]
+            val ly = ay - gravityLp[1]
+            val lz = az - gravityLp[2]
+            val lMag = norm3(lx, ly, lz)
+            forwardSampleCount++
+
+            if (lMag >= forwardTrigger) {
+                addForwardCandidate(lMag, floatArrayOf(lx, ly, lz))
+                forwardAcceptedSamples++
+            }
+
+            val elapsed = nowMs - phaseStartMs
+            progress.progress = (50 + ((elapsed.toFloat() / FORWARD_DURATION_MS.toFloat()) * 50f).toInt()).coerceIn(50, 100)
+            tvDetails.text = String.format(
+                Locale.getDefault(),
+                getString(R.string.smart_calibration_metrics_forward),
+                forwardAcceptedSamples,
+                forwardTrigger
+            )
+
+            if (elapsed >= FORWARD_DURATION_MS) {
+                finalizeCalibration()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun handleGyroscope(ev: SensorEvent) {
+        if (phase != Phase.STILL) return
+
+        val gx = ev.values[0]
+        val gy = ev.values[1]
+        val gz = ev.values[2]
+
+        stillGyroBiasSum[0] += gx
+        stillGyroBiasSum[1] += gy
+        stillGyroBiasSum[2] += gz
+
+        val gMag = norm3(gx, gy, gz)
+        stillGyroMagSum += gMag
+        stillGyroCount++
+
+        if (gMag <= STILL_GYRO_GOOD_THRESHOLD) {
+            stillGyroGoodCount++
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun beginForwardPhase(nowMs: Long) {
+        phase = Phase.FORWARD
+        phaseStartMs = nowMs
+        val baseVibration = maxOf(stillMaxAxis[0], stillMaxAxis[1], stillMaxAxis[2]).coerceAtLeast(0.25f)
+        forwardTrigger = maxOf(0.55f, baseVibration * 1.8f)
+        tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_status_forward)
+        tvHint.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_hint_forward)
+    }
+
+    private fun finalizeCalibration() {
+        unregisterSensors()
+        calibrationActive = false
+        phase = Phase.COMPLETE
+
+        if (stillLinearCount < 80) {
+            onCalibrationFailed(getString(R.string.smart_calibration_error_not_enough_still))
+            return
+        }
+
+        if (forwardTopVectors.size < 8) {
+            onCalibrationFailed(getString(R.string.smart_calibration_error_not_enough_forward))
+            return
+        }
+
+        val gravityAvg = floatArrayOf(
+            stillGravitySum[0] / stillLinearCount,
+            stillGravitySum[1] / stillLinearCount,
+            stillGravitySum[2] / stillLinearCount
+        )
+
+        val gravityNorm = normalize(gravityAvg) ?: run {
+            onCalibrationFailed(getString(R.string.smart_calibration_error_gravity))
+            return
+        }
+
+        val forwardWeighted = floatArrayOf(0f, 0f, 0f)
+        var weightSum = 0f
+        for (item in forwardTopVectors) {
+            forwardWeighted[0] += item.vector[0] * item.magnitude
+            forwardWeighted[1] += item.vector[1] * item.magnitude
+            forwardWeighted[2] += item.vector[2] * item.magnitude
+            weightSum += item.magnitude
+        }
+
+        if (weightSum <= 0.001f) {
+            onCalibrationFailed(getString(R.string.smart_calibration_error_forward_vector))
+            return
+        }
+
+        forwardWeighted[0] /= weightSum
+        forwardWeighted[1] /= weightSum
+        forwardWeighted[2] /= weightSum
+
+        // Remove gravity component from forward vector to keep it on the horizontal plane.
+        val gravProjection =
+            forwardWeighted[0] * gravityNorm[0] +
+                forwardWeighted[1] * gravityNorm[1] +
+                forwardWeighted[2] * gravityNorm[2]
+        forwardWeighted[0] -= gravityNorm[0] * gravProjection
+        forwardWeighted[1] -= gravityNorm[1] * gravProjection
+        forwardWeighted[2] -= gravityNorm[2] * gravProjection
+
+        val forwardNorm = normalize(forwardWeighted) ?: run {
+            onCalibrationFailed(getString(R.string.smart_calibration_error_forward_vector))
+            return
+        }
+
+        val maxVibration = maxOf(stillMaxAxis[0], stillMaxAxis[1], stillMaxAxis[2]).coerceAtLeast(0.8f)
+        DragCalibration.lockUniversalCalibration(
+            gravity = gravityAvg,
+            forward = forwardNorm,
+            maxVibration = maxVibration,
+            maxVibrX = stillMaxAxis[0],
+            maxVibrY = stillMaxAxis[1],
+            maxVibrZ = stillMaxAxis[2]
+        )
+
+        // Auto-zero lean for both orientations using the still-phase gravity reference.
+        val portraitLeanOffsetDeg = computeLeanOffsetDegFromGravityComponent(gravityNorm[0])
+        val landscapeLeanOffsetDeg = computeLeanOffsetDegFromGravityComponent(gravityNorm[1])
+        LeanCalibrationStore.saveOrientation(this, profileId, isLandscape = false, offsetDeg = portraitLeanOffsetDeg)
+        LeanCalibrationStore.saveOrientation(this, profileId, isLandscape = true, offsetDeg = landscapeLeanOffsetDeg)
+
+        val hasGyroBias = gyroscope != null && stillGyroCount >= 40
+        val gyroBias = if (hasGyroBias) {
+            floatArrayOf(
+                stillGyroBiasSum[0] / stillGyroCount,
+                stillGyroBiasSum[1] / stillGyroCount,
+                stillGyroBiasSum[2] / stillGyroCount
+            )
+        } else {
+            floatArrayOf(0f, 0f, 0f)
+        }
+
+        val quality = computeQualityScore()
+        MotionCalibrationStore.saveSnapshot(
+            context = this,
+            profileId = profileId,
+            gyroBiasRad = gyroBias,
+            hasGyroBias = hasGyroBias,
+            qualityScore = quality,
+            stillSamples = stillLinearCount,
+            forwardSamples = forwardAcceptedSamples
+        )
+
+        tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_status_done)
+        tvHint.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_hint_done)
+        tvDetails.text = String.format(
+            Locale.getDefault(),
+            getString(R.string.smart_calibration_success_metrics),
+            quality * 100f,
+            gyroBias[0],
+            gyroBias[1],
+            gyroBias[2]
+        )
+        progress.progress = 100
+        btnStart.isEnabled = true
+        btnClear.isEnabled = true
+        Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.smart_calibration_saved), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
+    }
+
+    private fun onCalibrationFailed(reason: String) {
+        tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_status_failed)
+        tvHint.text = reason
+        tvDetails.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_retry_hint)
+        progress.progress = 0
+        btnStart.isEnabled = true
+        btnClear.isEnabled = true
+        Toast.makeText(this, reason, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
+    }
+
+    private fun computeQualityScore(): Float {
+        val avgLin = if (stillLinearCount > 0) stillLinearMagSum / stillLinearCount else 1f
+        val linStillScore = (1f - (avgLin / 0.25f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+
+        val gyroStillScore = if (stillGyroCount > 0) {
+            val avgGyro = stillGyroMagSum / stillGyroCount
+            (1f - (avgGyro / 0.20f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+        } else {
+            0.65f
+        }
+
+        val stillRatioScore = if (stillLinearCount > 0) {
+            stillLinearGoodCount.toFloat() / stillLinearCount.toFloat()
+        } else {
+            0f
+        }
+
+        val forwardStrength = if (forwardTopVectors.isNotEmpty()) {
+            val avgTop = forwardTopVectors.map { it.magnitude }.average().toFloat()
+            (avgTop / 2.5f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+        } else {
+            0f
+        }
+
+        val forwardSampleScore = (forwardAcceptedSamples / 20f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+
+        return (
+            0.35f * linStillScore +
+                0.20f * gyroStillScore +
+                0.20f * stillRatioScore +
+                0.15f * forwardStrength +
+                0.10f * forwardSampleScore
+            ).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+    }
+
+    private fun updateStoredCalibrationUi() {
+        val snapshot = MotionCalibrationStore.loadSnapshot(this, profileId)
+        if (!snapshot.calibrated) {
+            tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_not_calibrated)
+            tvHint.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_intro)
+            tvDetails.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_ready)
+            progress.progress = 0
+            btnStart.isEnabled = true
+            btnClear.isEnabled = true
+            return
+        }
+
+        val date = if (snapshot.timestamp > 0L) {
+            SimpleDateFormat("dd.MM HH:mm", Locale.getDefault()).format(snapshot.timestamp)
+        } else {
+            "--"
+        }
+
+        tvStatus.text = getString(R.string.smart_calibration_status_existing)
+        tvHint.text = String.format(
+            Locale.getDefault(),
+            getString(R.string.smart_calibration_existing_hint),
+            snapshot.qualityScore * 100f,
+            date
+        )
+        tvDetails.text = String.format(
+            Locale.getDefault(),
+            getString(R.string.smart_calibration_existing_bias),
+            snapshot.gyroBiasX,
+            snapshot.gyroBiasY,
+            snapshot.gyroBiasZ
+        )
+        progress.progress = (snapshot.qualityScore * 100f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
+        btnStart.isEnabled = true
+        btnClear.isEnabled = true
+    }
+
+    private fun addForwardCandidate(magnitude: Float, vector: FloatArray) {
+        if (forwardTopVectors.size < MAX_FORWARD_VECTORS) {
+            forwardTopVectors.add(WeightedVector(magnitude, vector))
+            return
+        }
+
+        var minIndex = 0
+        var minMag = forwardTopVectors[0].magnitude
+        for (i in 1 until forwardTopVectors.size) {
+            if (forwardTopVectors[i].magnitude < minMag) {
+                minMag = forwardTopVectors[i].magnitude
+                minIndex = i
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (magnitude > minMag) {
+            forwardTopVectors[minIndex] = WeightedVector(magnitude, vector)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun normalize(v: FloatArray): FloatArray? {
+        val mag = norm3(v[0], v[1], v[2])
+        if (mag < 0.0001f) return null
+        return floatArrayOf(v[0] / mag, v[1] / mag, v[2] / mag)
+    }
+
+    private fun norm3(x: Float, y: Float, z: Float): Float {
+        return sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
+    }
+
+    private fun maxAbs(current: Float, candidate: Float): Float {
+        return maxOf(current, abs(candidate))
+    }
+
+    private fun computeLeanOffsetDegFromGravityComponent(component: Float): Float {
+        val normalized = component.coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
+        return (-Math.toDegrees(asin(normalized.toDouble()))).toFloat().coerceIn(-89f, 89f)
+    }
+
+    override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) = Unit
+
+    companion object {
+        private const val STILL_DURATION_MS = 4000L
+        private const val FORWARD_DURATION_MS = 5000L
+        private const val STILL_LINEAR_GOOD_THRESHOLD = 0.20f
+        private const val STILL_GYRO_GOOD_THRESHOLD = 0.08f
+        private const val MAX_FORWARD_VECTORS = 40
+    }
+}
